title: SpaceX 已向 SEC 递交保密 IPO 申请，承销商名单曝光
summary: 知情人士透露，SpaceX 于 4 月 1 日正式提交保密 IPO 申请，高盛与摩根士丹利担任联席主承销商，目标估值区间 $3500 亿–$4000 亿美元，S-1 最快 5 月初公开。

summary: Past ECB decisions offer clues to the value of using bonds as collateral, while US derivatives exchanges face a different calculation over their Bitcoin holdings.

summary: The FCC dismissed some of the key concerns raised by opponents, including potential threats to scientific research, because the agency determined they fell outside its regulatory authority.

summary: OpenAI will introduce a single usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines the Chat and Work experiences.

summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei pushes back against rivals’ accusations that he favors surrendering human agency to AI, even as leading AI companies increasingly automate their own research and model development.

title: Elon Musk’s SpaceX Gets FCC Approval to Launch AI Data Centers in Space
summary: The FCC authorized SpaceX’s solar-powered Starmind constellation, backing Elon Musk’s plans to move AI computing into orbit and reduce the industry’s dependence on increasingly strained power grids here on Earth.

title: OpenAI’s Changes to ChatGPT Could Drastically Cut Usage Limits for Paying Subscribers
summary: OpenAI is merging ChatGPT’s Chat and Work modes, forcing advanced conversations to compete with coding tasks for usage and leaving paying subscribers wondering how much AI they will actually get.

title: Elon Musk’s X Wins Court Judgment Against Alleged Bitcoin Bot Farm Operators
summary: London’s High Court entered a default judgment against Vivek Kumar Sen and Zamyang Sherpa after they failed to respond, though damages, which X estimates at over £207,000, won’t be set until a later hearing.

title: FCC authorizes SpaceX to deploy 1M satellites for orbital AI data centers
summary: The planned Starmind constellation will process data in orbit for use on Earth, as demand for artificial intelligence computing power continues to grow.

title: Flipkart CEO Kalyan Krishnamurthy to step down next week amid IPO uncertainty
summary: Flipkart's product and technology chief Balaji Thiagarajan will lead the company alongside its board until a successor is found.

title: Japan’s SBI, SMFG launch Solana venture for stablecoins, tokenization
summary: SBI Solana Global plans to develop stablecoin payment infrastructure, explore AI agent micropayments and tokenize financial assets.

title: Hong Kong launches tokenized debt platform with 24-hour settlement
summary: The HKMA’s new platform supports settlement in multiple currencies and handles debt issuance, interest payments and repayment at maturity.

title: South Korea’s crypto bill could move stablecoin race beyond token issuance
summary: South Korea’s draft bill favors bank-led stablecoin issuance but allows fintech and technology companies to become the largest individual shareholders.
